name: Question 1
problem:
A body of mass $2\,\text{kg}$ is moving in a straight line along the $x$-axis under the action of a single force $F,$ measured in Newtons.
At time $t$ seconds, the velocity of the body is given by $v(t)=\operatorname{tan}⁡t+2t$ meters per second.
Find an expression for the force acting on the body at time $t.$
